wiki.content: “Janice STFU” is Drake’s answer to all the online rumors and talk about his personal life. He uses the name “Janice” to represent the blogs, critics, and internet haters who constantly make up stories about him and his relationships. Taking the name from Janice Jose, head of brand partnerships at Universal Music Group. The song has a smooth, late-night R&B sound with heavy bass and slow vocal samples. This calm music matches Drake’s mood as he goes back and forth between talking about a girl he cares about and snapping back at the people hating on him. After its release, the song sparked widespread discussion across social media as listeners tried to pinpoint who “Janice” really was. People love how the track easily mixes a relaxed, late-night vibe with honest thoughts about how hard it is to trust people when you are this famous. Read more on Last.fm.
